stage1.name: Stage 1: spatial block CV
details: Pooled out-of-fold predictions from 5 spatial holdout folds; simulated mechanical negatives enter training only and are excluded from evaluation and calibration holdouts. Metrics here describe the raw constrained XGBoost score; Stage 2 describes the ungated isotonic event-buffer score, a different estimand from live gated scores.

Training includes temporal inventory-absence pseudo-negatives and simulated mechanical controls. Simulated rows are excluded from calibration and validation holdouts; negative observations are not field-verified.

confidence_intervals.method: 95% percentile cluster bootstrap of fixed predictions; conditional on fitted models; not retraining uncertainty

stage2.name: Stage 2: historical catastrophe hindcast
details: 48 event-time rows across 24 held-out case(s); Recall@K uses the top 10% by predicted probability (K=5); Recall@40 also reported with its actual K. Stable input order breaks tied scores. On small samples Recall@40 can be uninformative.

confidence_intervals.method: 95% percentile cluster bootstrap of fixed predictions; conditional on fitted models; not retraining uncertainty

dataset_build.label_policy: Inventory polygons, manual point buffers and precisely located reported-landslide point proxies are positive. Temporal absences are unverified pseudo-negatives. 40 explicitly simulated negatives augment training only.
dataset_build.provenance_policy: Raw report records retained; historical observations/defaults, simulated controls and alpine scenario assumptions remain distinct.
dataset_build.warning: Five source trigger/context regimes are represented but sample sizes are small and point locations are not mapped crowns. Historic burn severity, freeze-thaw cycles and construction geometry are not inferred from positive labels; missing inputs remain flagged defaults. Synthetic negatives never enter held-out calibration/evaluation.

pinls_training.scope: Requested sampling rule; not verified intact ground. Filtering evaluation negatives changes the estimand.

pinls_holdout.scope: Requested sampling rule; not verified intact ground. Filtering evaluation negatives changes the estimand.

event_group_holdout.label_quality: Balanced source-location event proxies and matched 60-day inventory absences, not verified intact slopes.
event_group_holdout.scope_warning: Small balanced multi-event benchmark; changed population, not comparable with prior Brazil-only metrics.

manual_point_label_expansion.note: Features were fetched or reused per cited manual source point; no user-supplied candidate location was labeled.

mapped_footprint_expansion.limitation: Rare regimes lack enough dated cited mapped polygons in the queried source catalog. Point reports are not expanded into independent failures; cells share inventory groups. Footprint labels can include runout, not only initiation.

historical_hindcast_export.probability_source: isotonic XGBoost event-buffer score; different estimand from live mechanically gated score

training_label_quality: Cited NASA COOLR mapped-polygon positives and manual point-buffer initiation-zone proxies plus 60-day inventory-absence pseudo-negatives. Negative cells are not field-surveyed intact terrain.
model_scope_warning: The model is exploratory. Polygon and point-buffer labels have different spatial precision; the held-out inventory group and pseudo-negative assumptions do not establish global or five-regime calibration.

label_policy: Cited manual NASA COOLR polygon cells and H3 cells within 300 m of cited manual COOLR points are y=1 inventory proxies. Matched 60-day pre-event samples are y=0 inventory-absence pseudo-negatives, not surveyed or verified intact terrain. Stage 1 reflects these assumptions. Stage 2 scores balanced source groups with complete spatial blocks excluded from model fitting.
